about.title: Mutlukal Gıda Since 2007
about.paragraph1: Operating in the Çorum Organized Industrial Zone since 2007, Mutlukal Gıda produces village-style flavors in compliance with the Turkish Food Codex, at a facility spanning 15,000 m² of open and 5,000 m² of covered area.
about.paragraph2: We sell part of our production domestically and export the rest to more than 20 countries.
about.missionText: To contribute to raising healthy generations by offering our customers natural, quality products. To bring innovative products, developed to high standards from R&D through production and point of sale, to consumers at fair prices — and make great flavor accessible to everyone.
about.visionText: Together with all our employees and suppliers, to produce delicious, superior-quality food in the most hygienic environments, to grow steadily, to keep increasing our brand value, and to add value to the industry and the country's economy.
